title: Discrete-time Fourier transform (L13–L14)
text:
Every question generates a new random variant each time you ask for one. A question is worth 6 points: 2 for the first correct variant, and more for consecutive correct variants. You get 3 tries per variant; after a submission a second hint unlocks and the full worked solution is shown once you have used your tries or answered correctly.

Lectures 13–14, Homework 5. Not on Midterm 1.
